name: single gamma
description: Single photon with LUCiD processing. Kinetic energy uniform in [1, 2130] MeV, matching the gamma entry in the config_01 bomb pool: the upper end is the endpoint for a gamma from a pi0 decay at the dataset's maximum pi0 energy ((E+p)/2 = 2132.8 MeV at KE = 2000 MeV), rounded down. A photon radiates no Cherenkov light itself - the light comes from the pair-production and Compton electrons it makes, which clear the 0.26 MeV electron threshold even at the bottom of the range.
